landing.title: The rooms posted in stories, now on a map.
landing.subtitle: Lloguer is not another property portal. It gathers the listings that never reach them: the room someone posts in an Instagram story or a WhatsApp group, so it does not vanish in 24 hours.
landing.demoCaption: From a story that expires in 24 hours to a reviewed listing on the map.
landing.demoPost1: Leaving my room on Blasco Ibáñez 🙌 €300 + bills, we're 3 flatmates. Move in next month, message me!
landing.whatLead: We don't compete with property portals. Lloguer exists for the listings that never make it there.
landing.whatBody: When someone leaves for Erasmus, moves cities or needs a flatmate, they don't put their room on a portal: they post it in a story, send it to a WhatsApp group or tell their friends. These are person-to-person listings, often more affordable, and they get lost within hours.

sources.title: Instagram stories
sources.body: Gone after 24 hours, and only seen by people who already follow you.

sources.title: WhatsApp and Telegram groups
sources.body: Hundreds of messages a day, with no way to search by area or price.

sources.title: Word of mouth
sources.body: Posters at uni, a friend of a friend. If you're not in the loop, you never hear about it.

landing.solutionBody: Lloguer gives them a permanent home: an open map you can search by area, price and number of flatmates.
isItems: Rooms and flats people leave behind, person to person.
Direct contact with the poster, by WhatsApp or email.
isNotItems: A property portal or an agency.
A place where you pay to promote your listing.
A middleman: we take no fees and handle no payments.
landing.trustLead: The good parts of WhatsApp groups, without the bad ones.
landing.t1Body: Post with a simple form and get a private link to edit, renew or delete your listing. No account, no password, no app.
landing.t2Body: A person checks every listing before it goes live, keeping out scams, fake listings and ads.
landing.t3Body: Every listing expires by itself after {days} days, so what you see on the map is still available. No ghost rooms.
landing.t4Body: We charge nothing, to posters or to seekers. You talk directly to the person leaving the room.
howPostSteps: Drop a pin where it is and add the price, a few photos and how to reach you.
We review it by hand before it goes live. You get a private link by email.
It stays up for {days} days. Still free? Renew it with your link. If not, it disappears by itself.
landing.howSearchTitle: If you're looking for a room
howSearchSteps: Open the map in your city or neighbourhood, anywhere in Spain.
Filter by price, number of flatmates and listings that accept your gender.
Message the poster directly, by WhatsApp or email.
landing.partnersBody: Lloguer is a non-profit initiative by Global Shapers Valencia. If you want to share it with your community or work with us, get in touch.

legal.title: Legal notice & privacy
legal.intro: Lloguer is a non-profit classifieds platform for affordable housing between individuals across Spain, run by Global Shapers Valencia.
legal.dataBody: We only process what the service needs: your listing content, including the WhatsApp number and contact email you give (both public); your private email (only used to send you the management link, never published, and it can differ from the contact email); and an encrypted identifier of that link. No account is needed. We do not sell data to third parties. You can delete your listing at any time from your management link: the listing, its photos and your data are erased permanently.
legal.processorsBody: To run, Lloguer uses third-party services that may process data: Vercel (hosting), Supabase (database, authentication and photo storage), Resend (email delivery), Upstash (usage limits) and Cloudflare Turnstile (anti-spam verification).
legal.contentBody: Listings are the sole responsibility of their publishers. We moderate listings before publication but cannot guarantee their accuracy.
legal.contactBody: For any question you can write to us at valencia.globalshapers@gmail.com.
